idea: Run simulated annealing over slicing floorplans written as normalized Polish expressions (operands are the n squares, operators H/V). Size each expression exactly with an LP that maximises the sum of sides, where each slice's width or height is shared and each leaf is constrained to be square. Use the standard Wong–Liu moves (swap adjacent operands, complement an operator chain, swap an operand with an operator). This explores guillotine layouts with continuous rather than discretised cut positions.
